newsitem.title: USA: Maine Yankee to increase staff 10 percent.
newsitem.headline: Maine Yankee to increase staff 10 percent.

text.p: Maine Yankee nuclear power plant said it will raise its employment levels by about 10 percent by hiring to fill 63 new positions and 49 vacancies.

Seventy percent of the 63 new jobs are in maintenance and engineering. The additions are needed in order to avoid excessive backlogs cited in last year's Independent Safety Assessment by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, Maine Yankee said.
The other 49 jobs are in areas throughout the plant. Maine Yankee's employment will rise to a record 550 with the additions.
"The staffing additions are a key part of our efforts to enhance our performance and help us restore public and regulatory confidence in Maine Yankee," the nuclear plant said.

Maine Yankee is 38 percent owned by Central Maine Power Co, 20 percent each by New England Electric System and Northeast Utilities, seven percent by Bangor Hydro-Electric Co, five percent by Maine Public Service Co, and 10 percent by other New England utilities.
